integrity: Executable exact finite quotient and separately implemented labelled-vertex checks are embedded together with their captured outputs. Finite experiments supplement, but do not replace, the exhaustive finite-quotient proof.
scientific_limitations: Results are specific to synchronous three-colour contact threshold two on complete tripartite graphs, and classify first-entry bounds and possible least periods, not basin sizes or other graph families. The exhaustive step requires replay of the two embedded source files. The 1995/1997 papers of Matamala and Goles were available only in abstract and bibliographic form; priority is not independently confirmed.
title: Sharp nine-step entry and fragile period-four and period-six waves in three-shore cyclic competition
